content: I recently purchased this foam mattress, and I am extremely disappointed with my experience. Right from the first night, it felt like sleeping on a rock; there's absolutely no support or comfort to be found. The foam seems to lose its shape within minutes of lying down, leaving me feeling sunk and restless throughout the night. Additionally, the off-gassing smell was overwhelming and lingered for days, making it hard to even be in the room. I also noticed it traps heat, causing me to wake up sweaty and uncomfortable. After a couple of weeks, some areas have started to sag, creating an uneven sleeping surface. It's frustrating to invest in what I thought would be a quality mattress, only to end up with something that hurts my back and disrupts my sleep. Save your money and look elsewhere; this mattress is not worth the hassle.
